packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates for anything already proven by CI, batched into one PR. Reviewing thirty individual bumps is how dependency PRs start getting ignored.
The framework and its runtime move together. next / react / react-dom in separate PRs would each fail CI until all three land.

Every @mantine/* package declares the others as an exact-version peer, so a partial bump fails to install. postcss-preset-mantine rides along because it compiles the CSS features the components' styles rely on.
drizzle-orm and drizzle-kit share a migration format; upgrading one alone can make `db:generate` emit SQL the runtime can't read.
A Playwright bump also changes the browser build, so the CI cache key moves with it — see the e2e job in ci.yml.
Still a 5.x beta with breaking changes between betas. Never batched, never automerged: read the release notes.
Pinned exactly on purpose (see package.json). Major bumps get their own PR so the changelog is read.
